main.description: One link of a community's authority chain, in the community account's repo (OD-9). Written only by the hosting PDS through com.para.community.act. Events apply in seq order; prev is the CID of the event with seq - 1. Each carries proof of the actor's request, so it verifies on its own.

prev.description: CID of the event with seq - 1. Absent only on seq 1.

actor.description: The account that took the action.

request.description: The actor's com.para.community.request for this action, in the actor's own repo.

requestProof.description: A CAR with the actor's signed repo commit and the path to the request record, as com.atproto.sync.getRecord returns it. Lets anyone verify the request without fetching the actor's repo.

offer.description: The seq of the offer or proposal this event answers: moderator.accept and owner.accept (required), member.remove and member.block (optional, when acting on a moderator's sanction.propose).

expiresAt.description: moderator.offer, owner.offer and sanction.propose: when it lapses. member.suspend: when the suspension ends. Computed by the host from createdAt.

createdAt.description: Set by the host's clock. The event's effects are judged at this time.

sanction.description: sanction.propose: what the moderator asks the owner to do.

target.description: content.*: the shared item acted on. briefing.*: the draft. The subject is the DID that holds the record.

targetCid.description: briefing.*: the CID of the draft version published or archived.

profile.description: profile.update: the presentation the profile record was set to in the same commit.
